Name: New Building - Winery (Casks Enabled)
Author: Richarizard
Description:
[center][img]https://imagizer.imageshack.com/v2/584x46q90/922/w90aXW.png[/img][/center]﻿

The Winery is a new building which allows you to place casks and age products.

By request, this is an alternate version of my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14664?tab=posts]Slime Hutch to Winery[/url]. This mod uses the same building asset, but does not replace the Slime Hutch. Instead it adds the Winery as a new building by utilising [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url].

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15134/]Russian translation[/url]﻿﻿ - PurplePrincess




[center][img]https://imagizer.imageshack.com/v2/584x46q90/924/QCyq57.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]: The mod loader for Stardew Valley.﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿: Loads content packs that change the game's data, images, and maps without replacing XNB files.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url]: Custom buildings framework for Stardew Valley.
[/list]



[center][img]https://imagizer.imageshack.com/v2/584x46q90/924/DJEO82.png[/img][/center]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest versions of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url].
[*]Extract [b]both[/b] [CP] & [SF] folders into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font].
[*]Run the game through SMAPI to generate a [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file, and then close the game.
[*]In the [CP] folder, edit the config file in a text editor, and configure the mod to your tastes. Carefully read the Configuration section below, and use it to guide you.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]



[center][img]https://imagizer.imageshack.com/v2/584x46q90/923/TE1phu.png[/img][/center]

When uninstalling this mod, make sure you delete [b]both[/b] of the related folders ([font=Courier New][CP] New Building - Winery[/font]  & [font=Courier New][SF] New Building - Winery[/font]).  Also, remember to check your other mods for any dependencies on Solid Foundations - if no other mods use it, you may as well remove it from your mod list too!
[color=#cc0000][b]WARNING: When this mod is uninstalled, all Wineries will be removed from your save game - along with anything inside them! Be sure to empty all of your Wineries before uninstallation to avoid losing your precious casks.[/b][/color]




[center][img]https://imagizer.imageshack.com/v2/584x46q90/923/g13sAg.png[/img][/center]

[font=Courier New]Layout: [b]Standard[/b], Expanded[/font]
Sets the size of the Winery interior. [font=Courier New]Standard[/font] is the default size which allows for a good layout of Casks/Kegs. [font=Courier New]Expanded[/font] doubles the size of the interior.

[font=Courier New]Style: Stone, Wood, [b]Panelled[/b][/font]
Sets the wall tiles of the Winery interior.

[font=Courier New]ReducedFootprint: [b]True[/b], False[/font]
Toggle whether you'd like to reduce the footprint of the building. The reduced footprint will not include the fence at the back of the building.
[b][color=#cc0000]WARNING: Changing this will not alter the footprint of any existing Slime Hutches/Wineries in your save game. This may cause anomalies with collisions and the Winery in your save game.[/color][/b]




[center][img]https://imagizer.imageshack.com/v2/584x46q90/923/fVK7Ks.png[/img][/center]﻿

This mod simply adds a new building to the list that Robin can build, it's very unlikely it will conflict with any other mods.
